results.intentUsed:
Exercise the inventory movement controls with boundary values, verify low-stock thresholds, and confirm undo restores all visible state.

Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. On a fresh page, select Panel A3, choose Received, enter 13, and note its on-hand value, total units, and movement count. Then Click Record, then click Undo last and reread the Panel row, totals, and movement log. — expect: Panel, total units, movement count, and log must all return to their noted pre-record values.
2. On a fresh page, select Washer 11mm, whose on-hand quantity equals its reorder point of 60. Then Read its status and the Items low total. — expect: Washer must say Low — reorder, and Items low must equal 2.
3. On a fresh page, select CBL-2M with 18 on hand, choose Shipped, and enter quantity 18. Then Click Record and read the Cable row, movement count, and movement log. — expect: Must show Cable on hand 0, one movement, and a shipped-18 log entry.
